Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class SecondFactorRequiredEntryPoint

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.SecondFactorRequiredEntryPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.AuthenticationEntryPoint
public class SecondFactorRequiredEntryPoint extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.AuthenticationEntryPoint
Sends a user who has presented a primary factor but not yet the second one to the second-factor page, after saving the request being served (typically /oauth2/authorize?...) so the sign-in resumes where it left off once the second factor is verified. It also records in the session whether the request is a step-up (SecondFactorRequiredException.isStepUp()), which TrustedDeviceFilter reads so that a trusted device does not resume a request it cannot satisfy (that would redirect back here again).
